```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(vegan)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
```

#Jointure 

```{r}
data1 <- read.csv2("data/collembola_data_year1_train.csv", header = TRUE)
data_site <- read.csv2("data/BISES_data_sites.csv", header = TRUE)

nb_vars_initial <- ncol(data1)

cols_to_remove <- c(
  "total_collembola", "Acari_Gamasides", "Acari_Oribates",
  "Acari_others", "Acari_total", "Other_microarthropodes", 
  "total_microarthropodes"
)

df_spe <- data1 %>%
  select(-any_of(cols_to_remove)) %>%
  mutate(ID_base = sub("_[0-9]+$", "", Echantillon)) %>%
  select(-Echantillon) %>%
  group_by(ID_base) %>%
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) sum(x, na.rm = TRUE)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "ID_base")

nb_especes <- ncol(df_spe)

A <- rowSums(df_spe)
S <- specnumber(df_spe)
H <- diversity(df_spe, index = "shannon")
J <- H / log(S)

indices_ecologiques <- data.frame(
  ID_base = rownames(df_spe),
  Abondance_A = A,
  Richesse_S = S,
  Shannon_H = H,
  Pielou_J = J
)

donnees_completes <- indices_ecologiques %>%
  left_join(data_site, by = c("ID_base" = "Site"))

factors <- c("site_group", "land_use", "city")

for (factor in factors) {
  if (factor %in% colnames(donnees_completes)) {
    donnees_completes[[factor]] <- as.factor(donnees_completes[[factor]])
  }
}

donnees_completes <- na.omit(donnees_completes)

```

#Regression Avec toutes les variables
```{r}
df_regression <- donnees_completes %>%
  select(-ID_base, -Richesse_S, -Shannon_H, -Pielou_J)

modele_complet <- lm(  Abondance_A~ ., data = df_regression)

summary(modele_complet)
```

#Méthodes du vif

```{r}
df_regression <- donnees_completes %>%
  select(-any_of(c("ID_base", "Site", "Richesse_S", "Shannon_H", "Pielou_J", "site_group")))

names(df_regression) <- make.names(names(df_regression))

regression_vif_stepwise <- function(data, cible = "Abondance_A", k = 10, seuil_vif = 5) {
  
  vars_explicatives <- setdiff(names(data), cible)
  
  for (i in 1:k) {
    # Ajustement du modèle courant
    formule <- as.formula(paste(cible, "~", paste(vars_explicatives, collapse = " + ")))
    modele  <- lm(formule, data = data)
    
    # Extraction de R² et R² ajusté
    mod_summary <- summary(modele)
    r2     <- mod_summary$r.squared
    r2_adj <- mod_summary$adj.r.squared
    
    # Détection et retrait prioritaire des alias parfaits
    al <- alias(modele)$Complete
    if (!is.null(al)) {
      aliased_vars <- rownames(al)
      var_alias_origin <- sapply(aliased_vars, function(v) {
        m <- vars_explicatives[sapply(vars_explicatives, function(x) startsWith(v, x))]
        if (length(m) > 0) m[order(nchar(m), decreasing = TRUE)][1] else v
      })
      var_suppr <- var_alias_origin[1]
      
      cat(sprintf("Itération %02d | R² = %.4f | R²_adj = %.4f | [Alias parfait retiré] : %s\n",
                  i, r2, r2_adj, var_suppr))
      
      vars_explicatives <- setdiff(vars_explicatives, var_suppr)
      next
    }
    #Formule VIF du cours
    vif <- sapply(1:k, function(j) 1 / (1 - summary(lm(x[, j] ~ x[, -j]))$r.squared))

    vif_res <- car::vif(modele)
    
    if (is.matrix(vif_res) && "GVIF^(1/(2*Df))" %in% colnames(vif_res)) {
      vif_values <- vif_res[, "GVIF^(1/(2*Df))"]^2
    } else if (is.matrix(vif_res)) {
      vif_values <- vif_res[, 1]
    } else {
      vif_values <- vif_res
    }
    
    max_vif <- max(vif_values, na.rm = TRUE)
    var_to_remove <- names(which.max(vif_values))
    
    cat(sprintf("Itération %02d | R² = %.4f | R²_adj = %.4f | Max VIF : %-15s (VIF = %.2f)\n", 
                i, r2, r2_adj, var_to_remove, max_vif))
    
    # condi d'arret
    if (!is.null(seuil_vif) && max_vif <= seuil_vif) {
      cat("--> Seuil critique de VIF atteint, fin de la sélection.\n")
      break
    }
    
    # Retrait vif
    vars_explicatives <- setdiff(vars_explicatives, var_to_remove)
  }
  
  # Modèle final
  formule_finale <- as.formula(paste(cible, "~", paste(vars_explicatives, collapse = " + ")))
  modele_final   <- lm(formule_finale, data = data)
  
  return(list(
    modele = modele_final,
    variables_retenues = vars_explicatives,
    vif_final = car::vif(modele_final)
  ))
}


resultat_vif <- regression_vif_stepwise(df_regression, cible = "Abondance_A", k = 25, seuil_vif = NULL)

summary(resultat_vif$modele)
```
